remarks: Fabulous Executive home newly built in Chapman Woods near Cal Tech  &  Old Pasadena. Beautiful Foyer opens to this custom home which offers a gorgeous half-acre lot. Newer roof  &  new plantation shutters. New paint throughout, newly landscaped, large backyard. Dramatic living room w/ high ceilings, formal dining room  &  large family room opening to gourmet designed kitchen updated in 1995. This desirable floor plan includes spacious 4 bedroom, 3.5 bathrooms. Gorgeous Master suite w/ large his and hers walk-in closets with huge double shower. 3 beautiful fireplaces, newly finished cabinets in kitchen  &  bathroom. Wonderful view to heated black bottom pool with salt water,
